description: This source file defines the static class DdlEncoder, which provides functions for encoding and decoding DDL (Document Description Language) text. It includes methods for converting strings into DDL-compatible text or literals, and utilities for validating and quoting identifiers.

classes.name: DdlEncoder
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding and decoding DDL text, handling string conversion, escaping, and identifier validation.

methods.name: StringToText
methods.description: Converts a string into a DDL text phrase, escaping special characters such as backslashes, braces, and comment indicators.

methods.name: StringToLiteral
methods.description: Converts a string into a quoted string literal, escaping internal quotes and backslashes.

methods.name: IsDdeIdentifier
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid DDE identifier, limited to 64 characters, starting with a letter or underscore, and containing only letters, digits, or underscores.

methods.name: QuoteIfNameContainsBlanks
methods.description: Quotes the given name if it contains characters invalid for identifiers, otherwise returns it unchanged.
